Dog was relaxed bodied on approach to kennel.  Leashed & picked up without issues.  Carried out of kennel room & to small PY. Once dog would settle body & become wiggly, handler would attempt to pick up again, dog would again make a yelping sound while flipping head to air snap towards hands, handler would quickly remove hands. Dog would return to front of kennel with a relaxed body, offered treats then removed leash by hand without issues.

K9 attended offsite event at Maricopa County Home & Garden Show. On approach K9 greeted handler with soft wiggly body. Allowed handler to open kennel and carry to transport vehicle without issue. Dog would approach front of kennel while having a soft tail wag.  Opened kennel door, offered treats, would be mouthy with treats. Explored with a soft tail wag.  Approached handler on own & when called for, soliciting attention.  Would be mouthy with treats while in PY.  Allowed all petting on side of body. Dog was closed outside for AM cleaning; standing with front twos on door; eyes wide; furrowed brow; tail tucked. Handler spent a few moments gently coaxing with treats and showing leash; speaking softly. Dog would take treats and sniff calmly; began softly panting with v shaped commisure; ears back. Handler cracked open kennel door and dog would push firmly with nose at door attempting to push out; slowly fed leash through opening; dog would place head down on ground sticking out of kennel door; laying head flat on ground unmoving; handler had to gently adjust leash with hand around dog's head in order to secure without dog escaping door; erratic pull out of kennel; no reaction to barking dogs; tail tightly tucked; ears back. Dog would be tense with tail tucked on the way to yard; would stop on leash; once in yard handler extended leash and held while dog paced around; dilated pupils; panting; approached handler and pressed body against; climbed up onto bench; allowed petting but did not really solicit. If handler sat or stood in place dog would pace around yard panting; jumping onto wall; if handler walked around dog would follow closely with body pressed to handler's legs; walked behind handler; sniffed from behind; did brief play bow with vocalization; did not engage in play with handler; not interested in toys; spit out all treats offered; tail position would remain neutral with no noticable tail wagging when interacting or petting. Handler sat back down on bench and dog would approach and allow petting all over; paced to catch pen and began pawing up on fence as if to climb but easily directed down. Hander picked up leash and dog followed handler outf yard; circling on leash; startled by reactive dogs on way back to kennel; retreated into kennel but immediately tried pushing out; handler would have to slowly drop treats down to distract while handler loosened and removed leash by hand; dog had muzzle pancaked at door again pushing out.
10/5/2026
Dog was locked in back kennel for AM cleaning, handler approached back kennel. Dog jumped up on fence and greeted handler and then returned to guillotine area. Handler presented leash and dog began pacing along back wall of kennel near guillotine. When leash was not presented dog would try to push out through gate opening. Handler tried several times to cast leash over head, dog would back into corner and begin standing up. Dog snapped at leash and low growled. Handler tried to get dog to approach gate opening with leash prepared, dog was hesitant but with time stuck head through leash. Handler secured leash, dog had slipped leg through. Handler was able to use misplaced leash to guide second leash on properly as dog stood at gate waiting to be released. Handler secured second leash and walked dog out to PY. Dog walked erratically, rubbing against handlers legs and hitting the end of the leash. Once in PY handler attached leash extension and released dog. Handler sat on bench and dog paced around yard, heavy panting briefly and then approached handler and solicited attention. Handler pet dog briefly and then dog returned to pacing yard. Dog placed front paws on the walls in attempt to scale wall and pawed at exit gates. Dog was brief with any prosocial behaviors and then would return to high FAS, pacing with flagged tail, heavy panting and avoidance of handler. Handler was able to retrieve leash and placed clip leash. Handler walked dog back to kennel, dog was reluctantly to enter kennel, handler used moderate leash pressure to guide in after stepping in and being able to lure about half way in. Handler held dog back and closed gate, dog tried to push pass but handler was able to close gate and maneuver leash off using clip leash. Handler left behind small jackpot.
10/4/2026
Dog was kenneled inside, backing up, tense, paw lift, handler tossed treats and dog leaned forward to sniff but remained at back of kennel, whining, low growling. Handler presented leash, dog continued to growl, tucked tightly into back corner of kennel. Handler went to outside of kennel and opened divider, dog hesitantly came out, pacing back and forth between sides until handler closed divider, opened door, dog was sniffing at opening as handler lowered leash, dog sniffed leash, wide eyes, handler attempted to place leash and dog ducked head to the floor, whale eyes, retreated to back of kennel, siting in divider entry, tense, growling and whining, handler would gently swing leash and dog would duck away, began lip curling at leash, handler spent a minute just gently swinging end of leash closer to dog, dog lip curled and growled each time it came close, handler reattempted with leash loop and dog snapped at leash. Handler stepped away to get a longer leash, when they returned dog was at kennel door but retreated again, hiding by divider, growling and lip licking, handler resumed tossed leash, dog would lip curl, snap, growl, but with repeated attempts dog would lower intensity, grabbing leash with little force, would come forward a bit to sniff at door but then retreat as soon as leash was near, pacing in back of kennel. Handler spent about 10 minutes in total, dog was still growling and avoidant but handler able to lasso leash over head, dog came out of kennel and walked to yard with moderate pull, low posture and avoidant. Came into catch pen, hesitated to enter yard but eventually followed handler in with tucked tail, exploring yard, tense, hyper vigilant. Came up behind handler to sniff them, then walked away, handler sat on bench and dog briefly came up to sniff them, flinched as handler slowly moved hand, ran away, pacing yard, ran up to gate, sniffing and pawing at gate, started jumping up, handler moved closer, kneeling, dog came up and sniffed, allowed soft touch along side, when handlerstopped dog turned and licked their hand, solicited further attention, sitting on handlers lap, looking around yard, panting. Handler gently added clip leash and adjusted stopped while petting, then stood up and walked dog out of yard, dog had moderate pull back to kennel, hesitant to enter, backing away, handler stepped in and dog followed then darted out, mouth at leash, erratic pull, eventually able to lead in with leash pressure, removed leash with clip

Once a pull request has been made, the NHP will be sent a confirmation email. Only an authorized New Hope Representative may pick up the animal.
Important:
If you forget your passcode or have other technical issues using the automated system, email
ACC Alt Placement
and communicate which animal should be pulled under your NH Group. You will also need to communicate the reason why you were unable to use the automated
system so we can address it.  Any Priority Placement pull request from a Non-New Hope Partner or extension request sent to
ACC Alt Placement will not receive a response.
Non-New Hope Partners selecting adoptable animals from the Portal must complete the adoption prior to the close of business on the animal’s deadline
date
